inverse_rules: an interface that is not a calibrated transfer for the stated context is not inverted: the request is not proposable
every candidate carries provenance (proposer, method, sources) and a pinned sequence artifact, and passes the forward checks for the target before it is listed as passing
an ortholog or homolog is not interchangeable: function does not transfer across species or contexts without its own context-matched measurement
the output is a candidate set with its provenance and the unresolved bridges, never a single guaranteed genome, and the compiler adds no sequence of its own
must_not_say: a working genome or construct was designed
homology or a marker shows a function transfers to this organism
an unresolved interface is a violated constraint
a calibration measured in one context holds in another

nodes.text: candidate sequence and construct (pinned artifact, never generated here)
expression and cell program in a stated cell state and stage
growth and material: proliferation, matrix and mineral deposition
fin shape and mechanics: ray geometry, stiffness EI(x), load
aerodynamic performance of the fin and body (forces, glide)

scope: an explicit dependency graph of what a genotype-to-fin design needs; every interface is unknown and nothing is calibrated
